evidence.irr: **irr 70（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　《機構》複数年の最低購入義務（未達なら価格見直しと financial penalties）＋中核PHOLEDドーパントの単一供給依存　『Our commercial supply agreements typically require our customers to purchase minimum quantities of our materials, which purchases can be in the form of annual minimum purchase undertakings or as a minimum percentage of their purchase requirements, or a combination of both.』（Item 1 Business → Our Business → OLED Materials（供給契約の条件））——複数年の購買義務そのもの。義務の主語が customers＝顧客側の拘束　『Generally, our commercial material supply agreements provide for multi-year purchase commitments, typically on a price per gram basis, which entitle our customers to certain discounts, technical support on the use of our OLED materials in mass production facilities, and access to certain future OLED materials.』（Item 1 Business → Relationships with OLED Display Manufacturers）——multi-year purchase commitments と明記。量産ラインでの技術支援＝工程への組込も併記される　『If a customer does not meet its minimum purchase obligations, generally we would have the right to review pricing for future material sales and impose other financial penalties.』（Item 1 Business → Relationships with OLED Display Manufacturers）——未達に**顧客が負う金銭的ペナルティ**。義務が名目でないことの裏づけ　『We provide just-in-time supply to our customers and serve as a sole source to them for many of our critical proprietary PHOLED dopant materials.』（Item 1 Business → Our Competitive Strengths）——中核ドーパントの単一供給。消耗品の専用性に相当する　『A potential customer could be hesitant to adopt OLED technology given the risks inherent in depending on a sole source for critical components and the inability to establish alternate supply relationships.』（Item 1A Risk Factors → We are the sole source supplier for certain critical components used in OLED technologies）——『代替供給関係を確立できない』を会社が事実として述べる。リスクの枠に置かれてはいるが、述べている事実は顧客側の代替不能　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『our agreements with our customers do not require them to purchase our host materials to utilize our phosphorescent emitter materials, and those customers may elect not to purchase our host materials』 ／ 『we have worked and continue to work closely with customers evaluating and qualifying our proprietary PHOLED materials for commercial usage』　《射程》ほぼ全社。BOE/LG Display/SDC/CSOT/Visionox/Tianma と長期・複数年契約を結び、『we received a majority of our revenue from three customers』＝素材売上と特許ロイヤルティの双方が同じ契約束の下にある　《検問と反証の経緯》検問1: 引用7本とも grep -F で各1件＝一字一句。検問2: 機構は抽象語でなく**複数年の最低購入義務**（brief の列挙そのもの）——『require our customers to purchase minimum quantities』『multi-year purchase commitments』、しかも未達には『impose other financial penalties』と**顧客側に金銭的不利益**が付く。加えて『sole source to them for many of our critical proprietary PHOLED dopant materials』＋『the inability to establish alternate supply relationships』。検問3: 向きは顧客側で、5類型のいずれにも当たらない（当社が取得する認証でも、当社の供給リスクでも、参入障壁でも、ONTO型でもない）。台帳の旧根拠にある『we have worked and continue to work closely with customers evaluating and qualifying』は確かに**願望形＝型(3)**なので、そこは採らず別の文へ置き換えた。検問4: 反証を探して見つかった3件を全部吟味した——(a)『do not require them to purchase our host materials』は**ホスト材料に限った例外**で、義務が掛かる中核のエミッタには及ばない (b)『sometimes without firm purchase commitments』はJIT在庫運用の但し書きで、supply agreement本体の最低購入義務を否定しない (c)non-exclusive 20件は**特許ライセンスの付与範囲**（UDCが他社にも同じ特許を出せる）で、顧客側の非排他ではない＝brief の『会社自身が関係は非排他と書く』には当たらない。★反証の試み: 50側を支える最強の文を狙って alternative supplier 0／second source 0／dual source 0／competing emitter 0／in-house 0／switch 0 を確認。唯一出た『will be replaced by a competing product or alternative technology』は**新製品の開発工程で採用されない risk**の話で、既存プログラムの乗り換えではない。落とせなかったので70。85にはしない——顧客が再認定の費用と時間を負うという断定文が無いため。evidence_gap: 旧根拠は願望形の引用＋『既存供給者を外す際の再認定を顧客が負うという断定は無い』＝**「85ではない」の証明**で終わっており、70を積極的に支える引用が一つも無かった（値は結果として正しいが根拠は規約を満たしていない）。
